decisions.reason: The modular plant concept was launched only a year ago and is merely mentioned on the website, so its results are still uncertain; it extends the established offer and can be carried with existing slack, though it may be folded into the flagship modular line C.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core recycling offer and has its own dedicated page, so it fits current aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
This multi-model line is the firm's stated flagship and strategic direction toward modular solutions, so management will keep backing it even before its results are clear.
The mobile trommel screen is a standard complement to the firm's mobile processing range, close to its established business, and is unlikely to fall short of aspirations enough to be dropped.
